text: Ethan - driving test 2 November 2026, 3rd attempt. v nervous. text him good luck the night before
Carmen's bday sometime next month?? check w/ Ines. into pottery atm - wheel class voucher?

Valentina - audition for the youth orchestra in the spring. practising 3hrs/day. ask how it went afterwards
Rafael & Lin - joint 40th party sat 14th @ the boathouse. bring fizz

Ciara's mocks start after half term. struggling w/ chem, says she can't sleep, her mum's hired a tutor but Ciara thinks it's too late. offered to go thru past papers w/ her on sun. she also mentioned her brother Pedro has his driving test the same wk which isn't helping the house stress. check in after the first paper
Pedro mentioned he wants a decent coffee grinder - hint for xmas
bday card for Bethany - post by fri. she's 30 on 3 Nov
Irina: theory test booked for March 2027. her dad Delroy driving her there that morning
Grace - results day was yesterday, got into Leeds for vet sci!! send congrats

Omar's brother Mustafa - bar exam soon, sometime before Christmas, Omar not sure of the date. Omar says he's a wreck, not eating properly, studying til 2am. their mum keeps calling him which makes it worse. Omar asked if I'd take Mustafa out for a curry one evening to get him out the flat. should do that the wk before, then text him the morning of
Abebe has a new puppy, Teff. collie x. pics on whatsapp
Lars' 50th cancelled - his mum's in hosp. call him next week
dentist tues 8:40. then pick up dry cleaning

Dana - viola exam the day before her bday (22 Nov 2026). party the day after so she can relax. she's been practising scales every morning before work and says the sight reading is what scares her. get her something small - she loves those Moleskine sketchbooks. maybe a nice pen too. text her good luck that morning
Marta & Elif engaged!! wedding prob summer 2027, Lisbon
Delroy into vinyl - collects old Studio One pressings. good bday idea
Ravi re-sitting stats in Jan. failed by 2 marks first time. ask him to come study at mine
Hoang - first gig w/ the new band fri. at the Crown. I'm going w/ Vera
Vera's daughter Kiri - ballet grading next sat. Vera v nervous, Kiri not bothered lol
Deepa - interview went ok last wk? never asked. message her
Sana turning 18 in the spring - big party planned, her parents doing a marquee

Simone & husband off to Japan after Christmas for 3 wks - Tokyo, Kyoto, then skiing in Niseko. first proper holiday since the twins. her sister's having the kids. Simone's into Japanese ceramics so she'll come back w/ a suitcase of bowls lol. ask for ramen recs when back
Kerry's cat Biscuit had op yesterday - teeth out. recovering. Kerry a bit shaken

Sofia - 11+ exam 7 September 2027. tutor twice a wk. her mum says she's anxious already & it's nearly a yr away. Sofia into horses + drawing, wants a riding lesson for bday (bday is in Feb). her dad Lars thinks they're pushing too hard. might mention a bit of balance when I see them at the bbq next month
Mila - Mila Okafor from work - leaving do soon, maybe end of month. chip in for gift
buy wrapping paper + batteries. sellotape
Ethan passed!! (driving) - celebrate next wk, pub?
Carmen = 'Carm'. loves Ottolenghi, vegetarian. bday 9 Dec
Ines - dissertation hand-in some time in May 2027. then grad. said she's dreading the viva
call Milan re: Valentina's audition - he'll know the date
Rafael's niece - GCSE results came out good apparently. all 7s+
Lin hates surprises - DON'T do surprise party. small dinner instead, maybe after her exams finish
Ciara - got her grade 5 sax result the next day, merit. pleased but wanted distinction
Pedro's wife Ana due in Feb. they don't know the sex
Bethany - Beth - mentioned wanting a Kindle Paperwhite, hers broke. she's 30 soon
Irina's stressed about the dissertation, deadline 15 January 2027. check in a wk before
Grace + Omar moving in together in the new year. flat near the park
Mustafa - got his results back, passed the bar. Omar ecstatic. card!
Abebe - driving test was booked for wed but examiner off sick, cancelled. rebooked spring sometime
Lars - running Berlin marathon Sept 2027. training starts soon. into ultra stuff now too
Dana's son - 1st violin exam tomorrow. text Dana that afternoon to see how he did

Elif - teacher, yr 6 @ St Mary's. doing SATs prep w/ her class all spring, says the kids are lovely but the head is on her case. she's also doing an MA part time, first assignment due sometime in Dec. tired. loves gin + true crime podcasts - bday is 4 Jan, good stocking/bday combo
Delroy's 60th - 2 November 2026. Sat. family meal, then party a week after w/ friends. don't forget card + vinyl
Ravi said Hoang got the scholarship! mentioned it in passing. message Hoang
Vera - knee surgery postponed again, now prob Feb. fed up

Kiri - Kiri Brennan - piano audition at the conservatoire 3 March 2027. her teacher says she's a natural. Kiri v nervous though, keeps saying she'll freeze. Vera driving her up the night before, staying in a Travelodge. results usually a fortnight after. ask Vera how it went the day after, and maybe get Kiri some sheet music she wanted - Einaudi book
Deepa allergic to nuts - remember for bday cake
Sana - driving lessons since summer. test 'soon' she says. instructor = her uncle
Simone - grad ceremony July 2027. her parents flying over from Rome

Kerry's partner Lin turning 40 sometime in Jan, Kerry not sure of exact date lol. Kerry wants ideas - Lin into bouldering + sourdough, already has a fancy dutch oven. climbing wall day pass for the two of them? or a bread course. Kerry also asked if I'd help plan a small dinner the wk after. need to send her links by fri
Sofia's grandpa passed last wk. funeral thurs. she's taking it hard
Mila into crochet now. makes amigurumi. yarn shop voucher wd go down well
Ethan & Ciara - first anniversary 12 Nov. he's planning a weekend in York
me - book own driving theory before Christmas. revise w/ app
Milan's mum Dr Rossi retiring end of term. Milan organising a do, I'm doing the cake
Valentina got in!! youth orch. starts rehearsals in Jan. she called me that evening crying

Carmen and Rafael - Carmen's audition for the am-dram panto went well, Rafael says. hears back sometime next wk. Rafael doing the lighting. Carmen worried about remembering lines, she's never done a lead before. if she gets it, opening night is 12 December 2026. good luck text the night before opening, then flowers afterwards

Pedro - his dad's 70th in March 2027, trip to Porto for the whole family. Pedro needs to sort flights asap, asked if I'd look after his dog Rolo that weekend. said yes. his dad loves port obviously, and old football shirts - Pedro thinks a framed Porto shirt from the 80s. maybe chip in
quiet wk. nothing much. maybe gym thurs
